sources.citation: KIRTADS (Director). 2020. Specialities and Life settings of Tribal People in Kerala, Vol. I. Kozhikode: KIRTADS (archive.org;gov.tribals.74697).
sources.note: Ulladan appears only in a list of Scheduled Tribes; no language description.

sources.citation: Nair, Ravi Sankar S. 2013. Tribal Languages of Kerala. Language in India 13:7 (July 2013), 58 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Contains 13 sketches (Adiya, Aranadan, Bettakurumba, Cholanaickan, Irula, Kakkala, Kani, Kurichiya, Malamuthan, Malaveda, Mannan, Muduga, Mullukurumba) with phonology notes, but NO Ullatan/Ulladan sketch; Ulladan is mentioned only as a group related to the Malaveda. Nothing on Ullatan stress.

sources.citation: Krishna Iyer, L. A. 1939. The Travancore Tribes and Castes, vol. II. Trivandrum: Government Press (ch. VI 'Ullatan').
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Ethnographic chapter on the Ullatan; no language/phonology section for this tribe; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Anantha Krishna Iyer, L. K. 1909. The Cochin Tribes and Castes, vol. I. Madras (ch. III.iii 'The Ulladans', p. ~59-60).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Only: 'The language they speak is Malayalam, and these people are all illiterate.' Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Thurston, Edgar & K. Rangachari. 1909. Castes and Tribes of Southern India, vol. VII (T-Z), entry 'Ulladan', pp. 215ff. Madras: Government Press.

sources.citation: Malayalam and English Wikipedia 'Ullatan language'; Wikidata Q8761579; Glottolog 5.3 ulla1237 page
sources.note: No linguistic content beyond classification (Malayalamoid; speakers shifted to Malayalam, dormant); references only Ethnologue and LINGUIST List.
